task.title: Enabling the IPv6 protocol family
task.shortdesc: To enable IPv6 support on your standalone Red Hat Quay deployment, you can set FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION to IPv6 in your config.yaml file and restart the registry.

ul.li: Your host and container software platform (Docker, Podman) must be configured to support IPv6.

note.p: If your environment is configured for IPv4, but the FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION configuration field is set to IPv6, Red Hat Quay fails to deploy.

step.cmd: In your deployment’s config.yaml file, add the FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION parameter and set it to IPv6, for example:

info.codeblock: FEATURE_GOOGLE_LOGIN: false FEATURE_INVITE_ONLY_USER_CREATION: false FEATURE_LISTEN_IP_VERSION: IPv6 FEATURE_MAILING: false FEATURE_NONSUPERUSER_TEAM_SYNCING_SETUP: false

step.cmd: Start, or restart, your Red Hat Quay deployment.

ul.li: After you enable IPv6 in your deployment’s config.yaml file, you can use all Red Hat Quay features as usual when your environment is configured for IPv6 and is not affected by known IPv6 limitations.
